semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Admin dashboard & operations
subtitle: Owner session gate, catalog, fulfillment, support, settings and audit

nodes.label: Open admin control center
nodes.description: Admin shell groups operations and navigation.

nodes.label: Require owner role
nodes.description: Server components redirect missing sessions, unauthorized roles or database unavailability.

nodes.label: Admin route handlers
nodes.description: Each API independently authorizes the owner session; no central middleware is invented.

nodes.label: Run selected operation
nodes.description: Actual services cover products, inventory, orders, customers, payments, returns, support and settings.

nodes.label: Stored business collections
nodes.description: Repository queries and transactional mutations use native MongoDB driver.

nodes.label: Audit critical changes
nodes.description: Critical owner operations record actor, action, resource, resourceId and details.

nodes.label: Refresh admin view
nodes.description: Admin client refresh hooks request current data.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
